hpWithdraw.description: End-of-battle HP withdrawn per living mech of this type (fixed; ignores pack level and purchase premium). Also feeds particle wave grouping via hpDrawWaveTier . Omit to use UnitType.cost / formation headcount.

unlockCost.description: Once-per-deployment shop unlock fee (supply). Only shop-buyable army types set this — omit for towers / board extras / unlisted types.

levelBasis.description: Supply value used for LEVEL price and XP thresholds when it must differ from cost . Spawn-only units are free (`cost: 0`), which made both the level price and the XP threshold 0 — i.e. instant, free, repeatable level-ups. Money (buy price, sell refund) still uses `cost`, so raising this cannot be farmed for supply.

xpValue.description: XP granted to the killer per member of this pack killed. Defaults to `cost / memberCount`, which is 0 for spawn-only (free) units and scales oddly for very large or very small packs — set it when the kill should simply be worth a fixed amount.

footprint.description: tiles this unit occupies on the grid (width x depth)

formation.description: how many individual mechs stand inside the footprint (width x depth)

meshScale.description: uniform scale applied to each mech mesh

sandPadScale.description: Soft sand pad stamped under a structure, as a multiple of its footprint (default 1). Visual only.

structure.description: structures don't bob and never rotate to face anything (but are valid facing targets)

baseAnchor.description: A base building every side starts with, and where it stands: the Stronghold at the back center, the research and command towers per seat (see BASE_ANCHORS). One type per anchor; buildings without it (a wall, a farm house from a level package) only stand where a scenario places them.

extra.description: board extras (shield, rocket): bought like units but never targeted or damaged by ordinary fire, exempt from the deploy limit and recruiting

notAcquired.description: Never CHOSEN as a target — an enemy walks past looking for something else. Unlike extra this is only about acquisition: the unit is still in the target hash, so a shot crossing it connects, and splash, blasts and fire all reach it. A Stronghold archer on a keep: you besiege the keep, and he takes what lands near him.

collapseOwnArmy.description: Its side's whole army collapses with it. Only while the match's `strongholdMode` is `'lifeline'` — the attribute says what the building can do, the match decides whether that is in play.

seatDebuff.description: The owning seat takes the tower-destruction debuff (window shrinks with level).

onDestroyed.description: What this type's destruction does to the rest of the board. Each effect is implemented once in the sim; a type only switches it on, so a custom building gets the behaviour by setting the attribute — never by id.

fixture.description: Part of a building rather than a pack: cannot be sold, repositioned or refunded, and never counts as field army.

diesWithHost.description: Dies — with no killer — when the unit it is mounted on (Unit.hostUnitId) is destroyed.

effect.description: `golden`: immune to tower/storm debuffs and takes reduced damage

requiresTech.description: tech on this type that switches the aura on; omit = always on

duration.description: seconds the buff lasts on a recipient

aura.description: An aura this type projects onto allies around it. The effect is implemented once in the sim; a type chooses it and sets the numbers. Applied once shortly after battle start and to units that arrive later.

abilities.description: Panel actions this building offers. `forge` also makes it the side's rune forge: runes are dropped on it, it can be lit, and its chimney smokes.

slots.description: `UnitN` pad numbers on the model, in fill order

unitTypeId.description: type posted on each pad (looked up in the match's type registry)

buyable.description: When `false`, players and the AI cannot buy or unlock this type from the shop. Omit or `true` = eligible (still subject to unlock / extras). Horde-only units set this false; a type may be both shop and horde.

horde.description: When `true`, eligible for The Komtur wave plan / forest roster. Independent of buyable — set both for dual-use types.

shield.description: shield extra: a dome that absorbs enemy projectiles crossing INTO it

rocket.description: rocket extra: waits armed, then homes onto the first enemy in range

flying.description: flight altitude in world units — air units collide with nothing on the ground

freeFlight.description: Free-flight layer (bats): flying is a low cruise ceiling, not a fixed hover band. Altitude climbs/dives toward chase aims and the mesh pitches at the target. Omit = classic flat air layer (crow riders).

targets.description: the can-attack matrix: which layers this unit's weapon can hit

collisionRadius.description: ground-plane collision circle per mech, in world units — nothing walks through it

blobShadowScale.description: Multiplier on the low-quality ground blob disc (omit = 1). Does not change gameplay collision — visual only.

colliders.description: simplified 3D hit volumes for bullets: spheres on the mech's local y axis (rotation-proof), offsets and radii scaled by meshScale at use

aimY.description: Optional local Y above feet that projectiles aim at (× meshScale). Hit detection still uses colliders — this only steers loft.

aimSpread.description: Multiplier on arrow aim scatter (1 = default archer wobble). Lower = tighter shots. Only applies when projectileStyle is `arrow` and not homing.

projectileSpeed.description: ranged mechs fire visible projectiles at this speed (world units/s); melee when absent

projectileStyle.description: visual for the flying shot — does not affect sim hit radius. `bolt` = energy bead (default); `arrow` / `largeArrow` = fletched shafts; `stone` = hurled rock (catapult); `orb` = wizard magic orb.

projectileScale.description: Scale vs the style's default projectile mesh (1 = archer/ballista size). Number = uniform. For shafts, `{ length, thickness }` scales Z (flight) vs X/Y (girth) separately — goblins use short but thick arrows.

projectileScaleEnd.description: If set (uniform number scales only), the mesh lerps from projectileScale → this over the flight path (xz), so a blast shot can start small and end near splash size.

projectileCount.description: How many projectiles leave the muzzle per attack (Stormcaller volley). Omit / 1 = single shot. Each shot deals full damage and uses aimSpread (or a default fan when count > 1).

projectileTrail.description: Soft VFX ribbon behind flying shots. `cloud` = misty smoke puffs (mortar / Stormcaller stones).

projectileLaunchHeight.description: spawn height above the unit's altitude (world units). When set, overrides the default collider-mid muzzle for that shot.

projectileLaunchHeightFrac.description: Muzzle height as a fraction of visual mesh height (0..1), above feet. Easier than absolute units — e.g. `0.75` ≈ upper chest / bow. Ignored when projectileLaunchHeight is set.

projectileBallistic.description: lobbed shot: aims upward and falls under gravity so long-range bolts arc. Without projectileLaunchAngleDeg , `projectileSpeed` is the fixed horizontal speed (arc height grows with range). With a launch angle set, elevation is fixed and muzzle speed is solved from distance (farther = faster shot, same angle).

projectileLaunchAngleDeg.description: Ballistic launch elevation in degrees (e.g. 40). When set, muzzle speed is derived from range so the lob angle stays constant.

projectileBallisticTimeScale.description: Ballistic only: stretch the solved parabola in time (same path, longer hang). 1 = normal; 2 = twice as slow. When set ≠ 1, aim is the target's position at fire time (no lead) so movers walk out from under the lob.

homing.description: homing shots re-aim mid-flight and hit ONLY their victim — a guaranteed hit (shields still block)

splashRadius.description: area damage: a projectile impact hurts EVERY valid target within this range (world units), not just what it hit. Absent = single target.

convertRay.description: Conversion ray — the Wizard's only attack. Progress fills at effective attack (resolved damage × level × tower attack debuff) per second toward the victim's current HP; at full, allegiance flips for the rest of the battle. Buildings, golden-aura mechs, and ward domes cannot be converted — the ray deals the same continuous HP damage instead. `recover` is idle seconds after a successful convert.

fireYawHalfDeg.description: Half-angle (degrees) of the horizontal fire cone around facing. Pitch is free; targets outside this yaw wedge cannot be locked or damaged — the unit must turn (via turnRate) first. Omit = 20°.

rampBeam.description: Continuous damage beam that ramps exponentially while locked on one target (Melting Point / Arcane Prism Cannon). Reach uses the unit's normal range . Starting DPS is the unit's resolved damage (talents included). At lock time t: `min(maxDps, damage × 2^(t / doubleEvery))`, then the normal hit-damage stack (level, tower debuff, vs-layer). Lock resets when the beam breaks (death, out of range, ward block). Optional `muzzleLocal` is rest-local (before meshScale) when the GLB has no AttackNode — typically the barrel mouth on a static siege mesh.

sandWeight.description: Ground wear strength when walking/standing (1 ≈ typical infantry). Omit = derive from cost + bulk via sandStampWeight .

deathWear.description: Ground stain / death particles. Omit = ash if structure, else blood.

deathAshScorch.description: Ash-death scorch on the wear mask. Omit = global big/small defaults.

bloodColor.description: Hit/death gore tint (hex). Omit = default red. Ignored when wear is ash/none (structures, siege, etc.).

bloodScale.description: Multiplier on flesh hit/death blood particles and ground stamps (1 = normal infantry). Small chaff (bats) use ~0.25–0.4.

fire.description: Burn / ground-fire inflicted by this unit's hits (projectiles, splash, rockets, melee). Ground fire stamps the shared hazard layer; burn DoT uses refresh + strongest DPS.

cleave.description: Melee disk: each swing hits every enemy in this XZ radius (no projectile). Combined with range as the engagement distance.

cleaveScar.description: When false, cleave swings skip the ground scorch stamp (still deal damage). Omit/true = stamp like a stomp crater.

splashScar.description: When false, splash projectile explosions skip the ground scorch stamp. Omit/true = stamp like other blasts.

cleaveShake.description: Camera shake when a flyer cleave slams the ground (0–1+; see explosion.shake).

burn.description: how hard burn DoT hits this type (omit = 1; 0 = immune). Air is skipped regardless.

corrodeOnHit.description: On projectile/splash hit: apply the corroded (acid) debuff to non-horde victims for this many seconds (refreshes).

innateTechs.description: Tech ids always owned by this type (even horde / seat −1). Used for innate battle abilities like Schwarze Spinne's brood production.

talents.description: Talents (`data/talents/<id>.jsonc`) a player may pick for this type, in auto-pick order: without a loadout the first talentSlots are taken.

talentSlots.description: how many talents a player may pick for this type (default 4)

itemSlots.description: how many runes a pack of this type can carry (default 2)

minRange.description: Minimum engagement range (dead zone). A ranged unit cannot fire at an enemy closer than this; it prefers targets it can still hit and backs away when everything left is too close. Omit / 0 = no dead zone.

piercesShield.description: This unit's attacks ignore Actor.shieldHp and hit HP directly. Melee contact always pierces (structural) — set this for a RANGED attack that should also bypass shields. DoT (burn / acid / poison) always bypasses, since it never routes through applyDamage.

meleeHitDelay.description: Seconds after the attack starts (cooldown bump / fire anim) before the hit lands (melee) or the projectile leaves (ranged). Omit / 0 = immediate. Same field for both — ogre smash windup and hammerer pistol draw share it.

meleeLunge.description: Melee only: start the swing this many world units before true contact range (extra surface gap). The unit keeps closing during the windup — reads as a charge / attack slide instead of plant-then-swing.

meleeRetreat.description: Melee only: after hitting a ground target, back off until this many world units of surface gap remain, then dive again. Flyers use this for hit-and-run (Wasp-like); air-vs-air stays in contact. Omit / 0 = cling.

meleePress.description:
Melee only: how close this unit presses while swinging, as a fraction of its reach (range + both radii). Omit / 1 = plant where contact is made and swing from there, which is how every melee unit behaved before the ogre. Below 1 the unit keeps closing while it fights — and, if it has a meleeHitDelay , slides through the windup so a big smash reads as a charge rather than a stop-then-swing. 0.85 = press in to 85% of reach.

Per-unit on purpose: a heavy breaker wants the slide, a line of dwarves does not, and the next melee unit may want its own number.

walkLean.description: Procedural walk lean *height* for non-skinned ground units (omit = 1). Scales bob / roll / forward lean. Speed (stun, oil, debuffs) still multiplies via displacement. Pair with walkCadence for step rate.

walkCadence.description: Procedural walk *step rate* for non-skinned ground units (omit = 1). Scales gait frequency only — not lean amplitude. See walkLean .

turnRate.description: Max yaw change while turning (rad/s). Every mobile type sets its own — small infantry high, siege / bosses low. Structures omit (never turn).

turnMove.description:
How locomotion couples to facing while turnRate applies:
- `track` (default) — move along the seek direction; facing eases toward it
- `pivot` — stand until roughly aligned, then walk (big spiders, ballista)
- `cruise` — keep moving along current facing while yaw eases (flyers)

proceduralModel.description: Named procedural mesh builder (PROCEDURAL_MODELS): ONE mech's meshes around the origin, facing -z. Used for the provisional height probe, previews, and wherever no GLB is loaded. A name, not a function, so a type definition stays plain data.

formationSpread.description: Scatters each member off its grid slot by up to this fraction of the slot spacing (0 = the usual tight rectangle). Deterministic — a pure hash of the member's grid index, so every client renders/simulates the identical scatter. Used by horde packs so a wave reads as a mob instead of a drilled formation; regular buildable packs leave this unset.

modelId.description: Id to use for 3D model / InstancedMesh-pool lookups (unitModels.ts, unitAnimated.ts, UnitInstanceRenderer) instead of this type's own `id`. Id to look up in unitModels MODEL_SPECS / instance pools instead of this type's own `id`. Lets a variant (e.g. HORDE_ZOMBIE → `horde`) point at a dedicated GLB. Defaults to `id`.

BuildingAbilityId.description: Panel actions a building can offer. Each is implemented once (HUD + action dispatcher); a building lists the ones it offers in UnitType.abilities .

DeathWear.description: Ground / particle residue when a unit dies.

oil.description: splash oil onto the shared hazard layer at impact (shield discs stay clear)

FireProfile.description: weapon / rocket profile — burn victims, ignite ground, and/or stamp oil

radius.description: how much ground lights up around the impact

intensity.description: DPS applied each step to ground units standing in the fire

BurnAffinity.description: how strongly a unit type takes burn damage (1 = normal, 0 = immune)

ProceduralModelId.description: Names of the procedural mesh builders (PROCEDURAL_MODELS must cover exactly these).
